summary: Verified the new Airbnb-style Flexible-within-calendar feature in WhenPicker on both Home (/) and /stays, desktop (1280x900) and mobile (390x844). All 9 acceptance criteria pass with exact spec match. Dates|Flexible pill toggle renders centered on grey #EBEBEB rail with white pill for selected tab. Flexible panel shows 'How long would you like to stay?' centered, 3 length pills (Weekend/Week/Month) with Week selected by default (black bg, white text), then 'Go anytime' headline and a horizontally-scrollable row of 12 month cards starting from the current month (June 2026 → May 2027). Each card has the calendar icon + full month name + year. Selecting a card flips its style to border-black + bg-gray-50 and the Apply button text flips from 'Pick a month' (disabled, opacity-50) to 'Apply' (enabled). Resolver math is correct for all three presets: Week+July → Jul 1 – Jul 8 (+7 nights); Month+July → Jul 1 – Jul 31 (full month); Weekend+July → Jul 3 – Jul 5 (first Friday of July 2026 is Jul 3, +2 nights). After Apply, the popover closes and the trigger label updates. Clear resets check-in/check-out AND clears the flexMonth pick (verified: trigger reverts to 'Add dates'). Tab-switch state preservation works (pick Aug, switch to Dates and back — Aug still highlighted). On /stays, applying Flexible Week+July updates URL to ?checkin=2026-07-01&checkout=2026-07-08 and the stays list live-filters to '13 stays' in a flat grid layout. Mobile (390x844): popover bbox is x=11.7 w=366.6 (fits in 390-wide viewport, no horizontal overflow), tabs visible, 3 length pills all visible on one row, month row scrolls horizontally (clientWidth=349, scrollWidth=1468), first card (June 2026) and last card (May 2027) both reachable via horizontal scroll. Visual mobile screenshot matches the Airbnb reference exactly. Regression: existing Dates-mode flow still works (calendar shows on default tab, 2-month range pick produces correct trigger label).

stays_mobile_390x844.note: stays-when-trigger IS reachable on mobile in this iteration (the iteration_29 finding that mobile /stays had no path to WhenPicker no longer applies — the trigger is now visible/clickable on the 390x844 viewport).

critical_code_review_comments: WhenPicker.jsx resolveFlexible() spec parity: spec text says 'Week → first day of the chosen month (or today if month is the current one), +7 nights'. Current implementation uses monthStart for non-current months, and `today` only when monthStart < today. This is correct, but note Weekend resolver mutates a Date with `setDate` while iterating to next Friday — this mutates the `base` Date object indirectly via `new Date(base)`. Safe today but a code-smell; consider date-fns nextFriday helper for clarity.

WhenPicker.jsx line 70-71: stayLength and flexMonth state lives in the WhenPicker component and is NOT reset when the popover closes/reopens. This is desired per spec ('state preserved within the open popover lifecycle') and tested OK. However, if the user picks a month in Flexible, closes the popover via backdrop/Escape (without Apply), and later opens it, the month card is still highlighted but the trigger shows 'Add dates' — minor UX inconsistency. Not a bug per spec, but worth noting.
WhenPicker.jsx Apply text on Dates tab when no range yet says 'Close' — consider 'Apply' disabled instead to mirror the Flexible-tab affordance pattern. Minor.

WhenPicker.jsx line 95-99: monthCards is memoized with empty deps, so if a user keeps the tab open across midnight on the last day of a month, the first card label would become stale. Edge case, not a real-world concern.

FlexiblePanel month-row hides scrollbar via inline `scrollbarWidth: 'none'` (Firefox only) — Chrome/Safari still rely on the default. Consider adding `::-webkit-scrollbar { display:none }` in whenpicker.css for cross-browser scrollbar suppression to match Airbnb's clean look. Cosmetic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhenPicker now has 2 modes via tab toggle: 'dates' (DayPicker range) and 'flexible' (Weekend/Week/Month preset × 12 upcoming-month cards). All testids follow `${testidPrefix}-{tab|length|month}-...` pattern. 'today' on the preview is Jun 28 2026 so the first month card is 2026-06 and the 12th is 2027-05. Resolver math: Weekend → first Friday >= base (clamps to today if monthStart in past), +2 nights. Week → base (= 1st of month or today), +7 nights. Month → 1st to last of chosen month. Reachable on both Home and /stays, both desktop and mobile (the iteration_29 finding that mobile /stays had no WhenPicker path is no longer accurate — stays-when-trigger now renders at 390x844). After Flexible Apply on /stays, URL gets ?checkin=YYYY-MM-DD&checkout=YYYY-MM-DD and the listing switches to flat grid showing N stays.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no bugs. Implementation matches the user-shared Airbnb screenshot and all 9 acceptance criteria from the request.
